title: Operator runbook: provision a real (non-MockLab) production tenant
description:
MockLab (tenant 319d3808-… slug mocklab) is UAT. First paying/real tenant must not be assembled from session memory.

Write a single operator runbook for prod (and staging-like) that lists every service and the tenant-specific vs shared config:

Shared (do not clone per tenant): ECS clusters, Fargate harness, BFF, CP, private subnets, internal ALB, harness service token, Daytona org/API, vault bucket name.

Per tenant: CP tenant row + slug/hosts, S3 prefix tenants/{tenant_id}/vault/, gateway instance (and later 0010 user instances), RBAC roles/path prefixes, chat_delivery persist, optional vault_plane if we add persist, secrets/material, allowlists.

Isolation: tenant_id on every BFF→CP→S3/Daytona call; no cross-tenant list/get; sandbox IAM prefix-bound.

Include rollback and a checklist that can be executed without reading this chat.
acceptance_criteria:
- Runbook path under docs/runbooks/ (or deploy/references/runbooks/) with a numbered checklist.
- Explicit: MockLab is UAT; this is how a second tenant is created in prod.
- Covers shared vs per-tenant resources, flags (chat_delivery, vault_plane), S3 prefix, instance, IAM, secrets.
- Reviewer can provision a dry-run tenant from the doc alone.
notes: Review bugs fixed on #514 (a43bd3bb). Register 201 no longer expects chat_delivery; 5.9 has foreign-prefix 403 curl.
close_reason: Done. PR https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/514 merged. docs/runbooks/provision-prod-tenant.md numbered checklist; MockLab is UAT; shared vs per-tenant; 0008 prefix; rollback. Review bugs fixed (register 201 no chat_delivery; 5.9 403 VAULT_CROSS_TENANT).
